## How to Display Menu on Footer?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-display-menu-on-footer/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go To **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> **Footer **-> **Footer Bottom Bar.**
- Scroll to **Footer Menu.**
- Select the option.
- Click on **Publish**.

To display the social menu, firstly you need to activate the Social links. To activate the social links: click here .

## How to add Background Image on Footer?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-add-background-image-on-footer/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go To **Appearance **-> **Customize -> Footer -> General**.
- Scroll to locate **Background Image.**
- Choose the option.
- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Change Footer Copyright?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-footer-copyright/>

## How to Change the Footer Widgets Layout?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-footer-widgets-layout/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> **Footer **-> **Footer Widgets Area.**
- Scroll to **Footer Widgets Column.**
- Choose the option.
- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Change Style of Footer Border?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-style-of-footer-border/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

To customize the footer border color and width, follow the steps listed below:

- Go To **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> **Footer **-> **General.**
- Scroll to **Footer Border Option**
- Now change the **Color **and **Border width** as you like.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Enable/Disable Scroll to Top Button?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-enable-disable-scroll-to-top-button/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

To disable the scroll to top button, follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Footer **> **Scroll To TopButton**.
- Put a checkmark on **Check to disable the scroll to top button.**
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to change the number of Widgets Area in Footer?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-number-of-widgets-area-in-footer/>

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Footer **> **Footer Widgets Area**.
- Go to **Footer Widgets Column.**
- Now select the value from option.
- Click on **Publish**.
